title: gaming
description: Gaming is structured playing: the activity of engaging in games — play that has acquired agreed rules, objectives, and outcomes upheld by its participants. An instance describes an episode of gaming: a game being played by players.

players.description: The participants upholding the shared frame.

playQuality.description: Whether the episode retains the quality of play — voluntary, intrinsically motivated engagement (see ../../../../../schemas/glossary/terms/play.schema.json); gaming without it is the boundary case (compelled gamification, compulsive gambling).
